text: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば　たたかえるのだが…　そうじゃ！

structure.jp: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば
structure.en: if our side had a Pokémon too

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending on a verb means 'if'. もって　いれば = 'if you had one'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: たたかう 'to fight' changes to たたかえる to mean 'can fight'. たたかえる = 'could fight'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a sentence part means 'but'; left hanging, it shows things are not that way. たたかえるのだが… = 'you could fight, but...'.
